key_insight: The RKHS reproducing property yields a kernel PCA reconstruction map that provably recovers standard PCA reconstruction when a linear kernel is used.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a computationally efficient reconstruction approach for kernel PCA applications such as image denoising and out-of-distribution detection.
method: Derive reconstruction using the RKHS reproducing property.
Assume the RKHS contains linear functions or the kernel is universal.
Extend reconstruction to random Fourier features through a corresponding reproducing property.
evidence_signal: Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets report performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods across kernel choices, with greater computational efficiency and robustness in settings where baselines fail.
watch_item: Verify that the chosen kernel satisfies the theoretical assumptions; the abstract provides no quantitative runtime or reconstruction-error results.
paper_title: Solving the pre-image problem in kernel PCA: The reproducing property is all you need
